facts.business: International Conveyors Limited is a specialised manufacturer of solid-woven fabric-reinforced PVC impregnated and PVC covered fire-retardant and anti-static conveyor belting for underground mining and material-handling applications, with complementary activities in trading MATO products, renewable power generation, and investments.

capacity_or_capex.item: Installed capacity at Falta SEZ, West Bengal
Installed capacity at Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company is hopeful of penetrating the market with new low abrasive belt with thicker covers from second half of financial year 2026-2027

auditor.name: M/s. G. P. Agrawal & Co., Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Dependence on international markets for underground mining applications
Concentration of investments (59% of total assets) with valuation complexities
Reliance on specialised product range for mining sector
Previous impairment of subsidiary investment (CHPL) due to negative net worth
facts.related_party_note: Internal reorganisation: acquired entire equity share capital of International Conveyors Australia Pty. Ltd. from wholly owned subsidiary CHPL by investing AUD 540, making ICL Australia a direct subsidiary effective February 13, 2026. No change in ultimate beneficial ownership or control.
